_meta.referraleasy.written_by: evaluation CLI / scheduler (sampled turns + judge scores)
_meta.referraleasy.why_longer_than_telemetry: Evaluation records are the regression baseline for agent quality. They are sampled at EVAL_SAMPLE_RATE (1%) so the volume is two orders of magnitude smaller than raw telemetry, which is why 30 days of retention still costs less than 7 days of traces.
_meta.referraleasy.note: A reader should be able to see the 30d vs 7d difference here and in otel-telemetry-traces.json.
